title: preset_save
description: Store the current shot as a preset on the camera, with a name and a thumbnail taken from the mixer now, so the window shows presets as pictures. Saving a number again replaces it.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera's id. May be left out when there is only one camera.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: The preset number, from 1. VISCA cameras take 1 to 256, ONVIF and Canon 1 to 100.
